task_definition.task_description: Please scan the living room for smart devices, then check the status of the living room light and turn it on to 75% brightness with a warm white color. After that, lock the main lock using PIN 1234, and then create a document titled “Trip Summary” using the result and send me a medium-priority app notification with the finance and travel tags.

user_input.query: Please scan the living_room for smart devices, then check the status of the living room light for device_id light_living and set its target_state to on at target_brightness 75 with target_color warm_white. After that, use lock_id lock_main to change the lock_state to lock with PIN 1234. Then create a document titled “Trip Summary” using the result, and send me an app notification on channel app for user_id user_001 with medium priority and the tags finance and travel.
user_input.title: Trip Summary
